description: Opt-in experimental staged LOCK controller for a new fixed demultiplexed div5 integration profile. Macro-OFF retains the default LOCK algorithm. The nine-file delta also includes explicit width extensions and non-synthesis initialization repairs; universal legacy behavior equivalence has not been established. This is not native waveform validation or a production promotion.

profile.schedule: Following accepted CE: +20 ns capture primitives; +40 ns compose boundary; +60 ns publication enabled; +80 ns existing SYS sampler; +100 ns next CE consumes old sampled value. Live permissions remain separate.
profile.portability: Not the generic adjacent-CE/CE_HALF or mux contract.

implementation.intent: Current-source experimental control law; no final st_n or effective-D fallback and no duplicated STEP dispatcher. Prefix and INTA holds remain separate. Reset cancels epochs; invalid profile transitions are rejected without abandoning owned LOW.
implementation.scope: Experimental controller; no complete native-conformance claim. Existing architectural behavior is intended to remain unchanged, with separately declared mechanical width and non-synthesis initialization repairs.

observed_simulation.M3: Original integrated omission finishes normally: old write-debt/added-write contrast is masked by ending=0 and no boundary permission. This FAIL is retained, not reclassified as an integration rejection.

synthetic_component.scope: Actual HDL compose component and one omission; independent integer addition oracle. Synthetic fields do not establish integrated M3 sensitivity or ROM/native reachability.

qualification.physical: Separately authorized diagnostic measurement cannot waive original failed qualification.
qualification.publication: User-authorized independent experimental draft; existing default CONTROL G6 pass is not accepted staged-RTL promotion, merge or flash authorization.
qualification.correctness_bar: SILICON MATCH remains the correctness bar; current evidence is engineering simulation and diagnostic physical measurement, not silicon matching.

default_CONTROL.scope: Default-system CONTROL only; experimental LOCK is pruned. 32 unconstrained inputs and 53 outputs plus 476 ignored absent-entity assignments prevent full-board/I/O closure claims. This does not establish candidate timing or 50 MHz pin performance.

staged_candidate_first_fit.scoped_reports: Same first fit, report-only copied analysis: 36 selected sets and 928 paths, actual point coverage, raw report and TSV counts/minima agree. All four corners have positive scoped setup/hold; this is scoped diagnostic evidence, not whole-design closure.
staged_candidate_first_fit.clock_interpretation: CPU10 via CEdiv5 is the requested functional profile, not achieved hardware performance. Fmax21.25 is the fitted SYS limit under all-20ns constraints, not NEC nominal CPU speed. No qualified internal CE100ns exceptions were used; any future exception needs launch/capture proof.

global_path_attribution.scope: Slow100 reported global paths, 48 levels ending at r_kind bits/replicas
global_path_attribution.classification: Physical source attribution is inferred from fitted report/node names. Async source ROM has no source clock; synthetic launch is not directly mapped to a CE-enabled source flop. Destination ss_we||srst||ce enable alone does not prove a multicycle exception.

physical.required_profile_closure: 20 ns applicable single-cycle endpoints; no universal 100 ns slack, no clock or G6 relaxation.
physical.constraints: The candidate SDC keeps every path single-cycle at 20 ns; no timing exceptions or PLLs are introduced. No firmware, private ROM assets or chip captures are added.

reproduction.cwd: repository root; existing public ROM table paths resolve here
reproduction.illustrative_build: verilator --binary --timing --assert --compiler clang -Wall -Wno-UNUSEDSIGNAL -Wno-VARHIDDEN -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-BLKSEQ -Wno-DECLFILENAME -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM -DV30_STAGED_LOCK_DIV5 -Ihdl/rtl/ucore -Ihdl/tb --top-module tb_staged_integration -CFLAGS -std=c++20 hdl/rtl/ucore/v30u_ss_pkg.sv hdl/rtl/ucore/v30_core.sv hdl/rtl/ucore/v30u_biu.sv hdl/rtl/ucore/v30u_ucrom.sv hdl/rtl/ucore/v30u_eu.sv hdl/rtl/nec_bus.sv hdl/tb/tb_staged_lock_div5.sv
reproduction.runs: Use the fixed positive argv list below; negative mutations are separate sealed diagnostic artifacts, not selected by merely setting a positive-bench flag.
reproduction.standalone_project: From hdl: quartus_sh --flow compile staged_lock_demux50 (Quartus 22.1, Cyclone V 5CSEBA6U23I7, seed 1). retention_audit.tcl is a bounded nonempty-register/path audit, not complete connectivity proof.
reproduction.publication_scope: Sources are byte-exact reviewed copies; the renamed public bench/module pairing is not claimed to have been rebuilt or retested. Illustrative command is not Linux-tested. No firmware or ROM assets are included.
reproduction.warning_policy: Inherited reviewed metadata/style warnings listed in illustrative command; structural width/latch/UNOPTFLAT warnings are not waived. No zero-warning universal claim.
reproduction.run_example: obj_dir/Vtb_staged_integration +family=0 +waits=0 +negative=0 +withdraw=0 +resetcase=0; execute one run for each of the 18 fixed positive_argv entries, substituting its values.

history: Prior instrument failures and M3 integration FAIL remain retained in local evidence. This checkpoint publishes no captured chip data, firmware, or physical bitstreams.
